notes: 'Thy' is given to the suffix of אֹתָךְ rather than to the article on הַשָּׁטִים, which is left unrepresented under rule 41's limit; the competing reading gives the determiner to the article and leaves the suffix unrendered.
In 'the east wind' the rectum's article takes the one written 'the', which English fronts (rule 29).
